name: Bihoro (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Bihoro town emblem in white: two bracket-like shapes flanking an eight-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Bihoro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 6 September 1937.

features.role: Bihoro town emblem — two bracket-like shapes flanking an eight-pointed star
